facts.fact: The article says the Rahaka system is implemented within a legal framework reinforced by decree no. 2025-1959 on the interoperability of public information systems; the decree's year is taken from its number, the article gives no adoption date.
facts.system: Décret n°2025-1959 relatif à l'interopérabilité des systèmes d'information publics
